DOLE.description: The executive department of the Philippine Government mandated to formulate policies, implement programs and serve as the policy-coordinating arm of the Executive Branch in the field of labor and employment.

DSWD.fullName: Department of Social Welfare and Development
DSWD.description: The executive department of the Philippine Government responsible for the protection of the social welfare rights of Filipinos and to promote social development.

DPWH.fullName: Department of Public Works and Highways
DPWH.description: The executive department of the Philippine government responsible for all safety of all infrastructure projects in the country.

LTO.description: An agency of the Philippine government under the Department of Transportation responsible for all land transportation in the Philippines.
